alt: Four quarterly planner covers, Q1 through Q4, in navy, plum and green.
caption:
Not ready to commit to twelve months? Start with a quarter.

The Q1, Q2, Q3 and Q4 planners have the same monthly pages and Weekly CEO Meeting system as the full-year planner, in a lighter book you'll actually carry. Each comes in navy, plum or green.

Q1 starts January 1. Link in bio.
